default/30632.htm.text: Warden Endrigo: Be careful! The Execution Ground is a very dangerous place where the spirits of the dead wander freely. They hate all living things... As for me, I guard this place, but even I can't go deep inside there. It is just too dangerous...

Q00229_TestOfWitchcraft/30632-01.htm.text: Warden Endrigo: Ismel? Ah, yes I remember him. He is in there. I suppose that he also turned into one of those ' nameless souls ' by now. A few days ago, he ran in there as if he was being chased by someone... A terrible shriek was heard... And he never returned.
